# Auxin System Architecture and Service Topologies

title: Admin Architecture Overview - Part 2
content:
## Purpose
Provides an architectural overview of Auxin's backend, frontends, and database services.

title: Admin Architecture Overview - Part 3
content:
## Content
Auxin v2.0 is built on a modern decoupled microservices-capable architecture.
- **FastAPI Backend**: Runs on Python (`http://localhost:8000`), presenting REST endpoints and Swagger docs (`/docs`).
- **Next.js Frontends**: Main App (`http://localhost:3000`) for Customer/Farmer/Delivery; Admin Portal (`http://localhost:3001`).
- **PostgreSQL & Alembic**: Relational database schema managed via Alembic migrations (`alembic upgrade head`).
- **Supabase Auth**: External identity provider for phone-number authentication.

title: Admin Architecture Overview - Part 4
content:
## Examples
- **Start Backend**: `python main.py`
- **Run Migrations**: `alembic upgrade head`

title: Admin Architecture Overview - Part 5
content:
## Notes & Warnings
> [!NOTE]
> Interactive Swagger API docs are available at http://localhost:8000/docs when DEBUG mode is enabled.

title: Admin Architecture Overview - Part 6
content:
## Summary
Auxin combines a FastAPI backend, dual Next.js frontends, PostgreSQL schema, and Supabase authentication.

## Purpose
Explains how customers register, authenticate using phone number and password, and maintain active sessions.

title: Customer Registration Auth - Part 3
content:
## Content
Auxin implements phone-number-first authentication powered by Supabase Auth.
- **Login Credentials**: Customers log in using their primary mobile number and chosen password.
- **Synthetic Email Mapping**: Behind the scenes, the system maps phone numbers (e.g. `+919876543210`) to synthetic email addresses (`9876543210@auxin.app`) for Supabase compatibility.
- **JWT Token Session**: Successful logins return a JSON Web Token (JWT) authorizing API calls to backend endpoints.
- **Session Persistence**: Sessions persist securely across page refreshes via Supabase Client SDK and Zustand middleware.

title: Customer Registration Auth - Part 4
content:

- **Login Payload**: `POST /auth/login` with `{"phone": "+919876543210", "password": "SecurePassword123"}`
- **Synthetic Email Format**: `9876543210@auxin.app`

title: Customer Registration Auth - Part 5
content:
## Notes & Warnings
> [!NOTE]
> Users do not need an actual email inbox. All OTPs and alerts are delivered to their mobile phone number.

title: Customer Registration Auth - Part 6
content:
## Summary
Customers authenticate via mobile phone numbers mapped to synthetic Supabase emails, receiving JWT tokens for persistent sessions.

title: Payments Escrow Architecture - Part 3
content:
## Content
Auxin uses a secure escrow payment architecture to protect buyers and sellers.
- **Payment Creation**: Client calls `POST /payments/create` to generate a Razorpay order ID.
- **Razorpay Modal**: Customer completes payment via UPI, card, or netbanking on Razorpay modal.
- **Signature Verification**: Client sends payment signature to `POST /payments/verify`.
- **Escrow Hold**: Verified payments enter `paid` state and funds are held in escrow until delivery completion.

title: Payments Escrow Architecture - Part 4
